jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Charleston School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Charleston).
North Country Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's board page).

sources.note: Charleston School Board page (North Country SU, official), 2026-2027 block: Mary Esposito (Chair), Sarah Jenness (Vice Chair), Rebecca Midthun (Clerk) -- the same three sit in the board's October 14, 2026 and March 11, 2026 minutes. The board is three directors elected at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)). Published terms (town annual reports): Esposito to 2027, Jenness to 2025 as last published in 2024 (her current term, on the section 423(a) stagger and continuous service, runs to 2028).

Rebecca Midthun sits as a Charleston director from the March 13, 2024 reorganization meeting onward (NCSU board page; October 14, 2026 minutes). Ryan Besaw, who held the third seat into early 2024, is absent from the February 14, 2024 minutes and no appointment motion for Midthun appears in any minutes from February 2024 to February 2026 -- she is recorded as elected at the March 5, 2024 annual meeting on that minutes chain. Her exact term end is UNRESOLVED (2026-remainder vs. fresh term; the March 2024 warning/results and a March 2026 Charleston return are not posted), so no term end is stated for her seat.
